page.overview:
Who is 3223 Orange Fish?

3223 Orange Fish is a LEGO Creator set that was released in 2003.

It contains 43 pieces to build an "orange fish". It is identical to 65448 Bonus/Value Pack.

In LEGO, 3223 Orange Fish sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
